purpose: Inherited direct __call defers its body and keeps its real Child receiver through force-close.
source:
<?php
class Base85A {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [85], '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base85A', '|', static::class === 'Child85A', '|';
        try { yield 85; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $this instanceof Child85A, '|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child85A extends Base85A {}
$maker = new Child85A();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
echo 'OPEN|';
$g = $maker->open(85);
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 85, '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
unset($weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: Inherited direct __callStatic retains its real packed object until natural completion, then closes with payload dead and return86.
source:
<?php
class Payload85B { public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG|'; } }
function NewPayload85B() {
    global $weakPayload;
    $payload = new Payload85B();
    $weakPayload = WeakReference::create($payload);
    return $payload;
}
class Base85B {
    public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weakPayload;
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', count($arguments) === 1, '|',
             $arguments[0] === $weakPayload->get(), '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base85B', '|', static::class === 'Child85B', '|';
        try { yield 85; return 86; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakPayload->get() !== null, '|'; }
    }
}
class Child85B extends Base85B {}
echo 'OPEN|';
$g = Child85B::open(NewPayload85B());
echo 'FRESH|', $weakPayload->get() !== null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 85, '|';
$g->next();
echo 'AFTER|', $weakPayload->get() === null, '|RETURN|', $g->getReturn() === 86, '|';
unset($g, $weakPayload);
echo 'E';

<?php
class Old85C {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [85], '|',
             static::class === 'Old85C', '|', $this === $weak->get(), '|';
        try { yield 85; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $this === $weak->get(), '|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class Other85C {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'NEW|'; }
}
function Replace85C() {
    global $maker, $weak;
    $maker = new Other85C();
    echo 'REPLACE|', $weak->get() !== null, '|';
    return 85;
}
$maker = new Old85C();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->open(Replace85C());
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() !== null, '|', $maker instanceof Other85C, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 85, '|';
unset($g);
echo 'AFTER|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
unset($maker, $weak);
echo 'E';
